queer_characters.name: Frankie
queer_characters.notes: The film explicitly shows Frankie having anonymous sex with men while resisting a gay label, insisting he 'has sex with men' rather than identifying as gay. Portrayed with nuance as a closeted, questioning adolescent, but framed within homophobic violence and no clean resolution, making the rep mixed rather than wholly affirming.
